title: 上海高考翻译背诵-77-25一模闵行

items.zh: 这位幼儿园退休教师最近迷上了烹饪。
items.en: The retried kindergarten teacher has been fond of cooking recently.

items.zh: 健康顾问建议服用药草来促进康复。
items.en: The health consultant recommended taking herbs to promote recovery.

items.zh: 社区志愿者在共享单车的把手上安装了防风手套,好贴心呀!
items.en: It is considerate of community volunteers to equip the handles of shared bicycles with windproof gloves.

items.zh: 随着一系列优惠政策落地,电动车企业对推动电池技术走向国际市场很乐观
items.en: With a series of preferential policies implemented, EV enterprises are optimistic about the prospect of bringing battery technology to the international market.
